free_tier.stated: Budget line 'Pico' at EUR 25.00/year: 1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB NVMe SSD, 1 TB bandwidth, sold in Poland and the USA (the tracker names Gdansk and New Jersey). The page prices each plan at its shortest billing term, so the Pico plans are annual-only and no monthly price is published for them; the Budget 'Nano' is EUR 3.00/month with 1 GB and 15 GB, and the Pro line's 'Pico' is EUR 30.00/year with the same 512 MB and 10 GB shape. The order pages answer WHMCS 'Out of stock' with orders suspended, so the cart prices nothing while the suspension stands; no renewal price is published on any page read.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month is the stated allowance on this plan; the card states no overage price and no throttle, so the post-allowance behaviour is unverified

record.notes: The vendor card states the annual price and the tracker states the monthly equivalent, so the two agree on the plan. The vendor's own no-KYC claim is recorded in the evidence rather than in identity_cost, because the signup page itself was not fetched and the field therefore stays at the email floor. Unverified: whether EUR 25.00/year renews at the same rate, and whether the 1 TB is enforced or shaped; the card states neither. Rendering and provenance: currency symbols are written out (EUR, GBP, RUB, VND), diacritics in place names are folded to ASCII, and a price the page splits across two lines is joined as value/period; the tracker page stated 'Database update: 7 hours ago' when it was read on 2026-10-22.
